structure.primary_monthly: P3-P6 monthly test (October & November in Term 1; March & April in Term 2): short paper answerable in about one class period, worth 5 marks of year work each. Ministry also issues weekly assessments (Models A/B/C) in the Performance Tasks & Assessments book. Typical sections: Choose the correct answer / Complete / Answer the following (story problems). Sources: parlmany.com 30-Oct-2025; dostor.org 7-Oct-2025.
structure.primary_term: P3-P6 end-of-term maths paper: 30 marks (doubled to 60 in some years), 1.5 hours, questions ordered easy to hard, MCQ always 4 options with one correct. 2024/25 Term 1 spec: Group 1 = 9 multiple-choice items x 1 mark; Group 2 = 7 essay/constructed-response items x 3 marks. 2023/24 Term 2 spec (P4-6): 7 MCQ + 8 completion + 7 MCQ + 4 essay x 2 = 30. Year work = 40% (performance tasks 10, homework notebook 5, activities 5, two monthly tests 5+5, behaviour 5 as reported Oct 2025). The 2025/26 and 2026/27 specs were not found; check the ministry's announcement each December/April.
structure.prep_term: Prep 1 end-of-term maths exam: 30 marks, 2 hours (one paper covering algebra, statistics and geometry; Prep 2 is split into two papers of 15). Year work = 70 marks (two monthly tests, 15% each; weekly assessment; homework; behaviour). MCQ always 4 options, one correct. Usual layout: Q1 Choose, Q2 Complete, then 3 constructed-response questions (algebra/statistics and geometry with 'Given / Required / Proof').
structure.notes: Monthly tests for Prep 1-2 are 15% each; no monthly tests in Prep 3. Exam questions on English-edition papers use the same instruction phrases listed in 'instructions'.
